title: Code and data for: An Explainable Machine Learning and Optimization Framework for Irrigation-Constrained Multi-Crop Decision Support in Northwest Bangladesh
description: Code, input data and reference outputs of a district-level analysis of irrigation-constrained crop allocation in the 16 districts of northwest Bangladesh: a linear allocation model with explicit fallow and a floor on the Boro rice area, decision-time yield forecasts and their decision value, a Gamma-robust water constraint, FAO-56 crop water requirements, a relative water scarcity index, alternate wetting and drying, a six-crop variant with lentil and mustard, and the model value of water. One command reproduces all 91 output tables exactly and writes the 14 figures of the paper; a notebook runs the analysis step by step.
